notes: Input locators and neutral description were empty; the supplied replication report independently identifies original target as Table 2 Panel A column 1: pooled Any ACT subsidy effect on Took ACT. Original extracted from title-verified NBER working-paper version (Working Paper 17943, cover March 2012), not a verified published-journal PDF; publisher DOI route returned a challenge. Appendix Table A7 explicitly prints the unadjusted p-value 0.022 under the matching 0.187 coefficient. This conflicts with the Table 2 significance stars (1 percent level); the explicit printed p-value is retained with confident=false. No p was calculated. The Table 2 joint-null p-value is a different test and was not used. Replication source is the final SCORE report linked by the supplied OSF file identifier; q4fpr project title matches supplied reference. Replication intervention combines diagnostic test and conditional subsidy, a documented design deviation, not a source mismatch.
